main_captions.1: 指南判断的反事实配对类型。A/P保持决定性证据，C/F改变真值；F0另行统计。
main_captions.2: 医学评测数据集。官方发布、本地可用和实际评价规模分列；原生划分与本地派生划分分别注明。
main_captions.3: Qwen3-8B受控留出结果。干扰2,293对，证据40对，自然节点372个，动态路径806条。RMS以logit计，DU以百分比计；Dir. Deg.为证据方向退化数量。扩展配置使用冻结修正函数，不能与官方测试混合。
main_captions.4: MEGA-CDP官方测试的7,458条动态路径。区间为来源簇配对重采样所得95%区间；差值以百分点计，相对于Base Model。Fixed/New Errors分别为同一已评价全集上的纠正与新增错误。
main_captions.5: NLI4CT-2024官方测试的5,500条声明。所有修正函数及截距在MEGA上拟合并冻结，属于零样本迁移。
main_captions.6: NLI官方原生配对响应。RMS针对4,136个标签保持对，ER与Pair Acc.针对864个真实翻转对；Correct Direction的分母为全部864对，与条件方向退化率不同。RMS单位为logit。
main_captions.7: 固定MEGA原错误池结果。路径修复分母为424；忠实性另用受控留出A27对与C/F21对，方向栏为数量。尚未复测原正确全集，不能推算净收益。
main_captions.8: 固定NLI原错误池结果。记录修复分母为1,469，原生保持/翻转错误配对分别为1,606/336对。NLI监督残差及NLI截距适配使用目标任务train标签，其余配置冻结迁移。
main_captions.9: MedPIC冻结迁移实测：467题、2,335选项、244个翻转选项对。Set EM要求整题集合完全正确；配对正确数以选项对为单位。RMS单位为logit，Dir. Deg.为计数。
main_captions.10: MedPIC的216个标签保持选项对。患者事实仍改变，因此本表不将其命名为纯干扰；三种RMS分别为原响应、修正后响应和方法引起的配对差改动，单位均为logit。
main_captions.11: MedPIC固定324个原错误题的合法集合解码与截距适配。四方法共享解码规则，截距分别在独立93题开发集合拟合；正确数不代表完整467题准确率。
main_captions.12: MedPIC固定177个翻转错误选项对。配对全对数分别在合法集合解码与截距适配后计算；ER、修正RMS与方向退化按连续分数评价，截距不改变配对差。
main_captions.13: MedPIC五模型模拟概览。忠实性为ER、修正RMS和条件方向退化率；Pair EM以92病例对计，Set EM以467题计。每病例对含变化选项，方向退化以原正向变化选项对为分母。预设模拟，未运行对应模型与数据集，待真实评测替换。
main_captions.14: MedPAIR五模型模拟概览。低相关删除的VR与关键删除响应保留分别报告；Key-Del. Ret.是固定margin敏感性，不是真值翻转ER；准确率仅针对898道完整原题。预设模拟，未运行对应模型与数据集，待真实评测替换。
main_captions.15: MedEinst五模型模拟概览。每种子5,383个control/trap对；条件方向退化与Pair Acc.分别评价响应和双端正确性；BTR以control正确对为分母。预设模拟，未运行对应模型与数据集，待真实评测替换。
main_captions.16: MedGUIDE五模型模拟概览。每种子7,747题、17个疾病组；疾病组等权宏平均。无有效干预配对的忠实性指标填“—”。预设模拟，未运行对应模型与数据集，待真实评测替换。
main_captions.17: TrialGPT五模型模拟概览。1,000条生成标签中排除250未知，750确定标签用于Balanced Acc.与Macro-F1；无干预配对指标填“—”。预设模拟，未运行对应模型与数据集，待真实评测替换。
main_captions.18: 受控留出的关键消融。各行共享原始划分，分别改变证据约束、痕迹维数和子空间；RMS单位为logit，计数均保留各自分母。
main_captions.19: 同痕迹的函数形式与修正位置对照。非线性及表示编辑报告三个训练种子的均值±样本标准差，非生成种子波动；系数栏含独立截距b。RMS单位为logit，DU以百分比计。
main_captions.20: 忠实性失败类型与可观察证据。各条件用于解释现有结果，不作为额外实测结论。

acl_captions.3: Controlled held-out results with Qwen3-8B: 2,293 interference pairs, 40 evidence pairs, 372 natural nodes and 806 paths. RMS values are in logits; DU is a percentage. Dir. Deg. reports counts, not conditional rates. Expanded configurations are evaluated using their frozen outputs.
acl_captions.4: Official MEGA-CDP test results on 7,458 dynamic paths. Intervals are 95\% paired cluster-bootstrap intervals; accuracy differences are percentage points relative to the Base Model. Fixed/New Errors use the same evaluated cases.
acl_captions.5: Official NLI4CT-2024 test results on 5,500 statements. Correction functions and biases are frozen after fitting on MEGA; this is zero-shot transfer.
acl_captions.6: Native NLI intervention responses. RMS uses 4,136 label-preserving pairs, whereas ER, paired accuracy and correct-direction counts use 864 label-changing pairs. The last column uses all changing pairs, not the eligible denominator of direction degradation. RMS is in logits.
acl_captions.7: Retesting a fixed pool of 424 original MEGA error paths. Faithfulness is measured separately on 27 previously used interference error pairs and 21 evidence error pairs. Full-set net gains cannot be inferred.
acl_captions.8: Retesting 1,469 original NLI errors, with faithfulness on 1,606 preserving and 336 changing error pairs. Target-task supervised and NLI-bias adaptation use NLI training labels; frozen transfer methods are reported separately.
acl_captions.9: Frozen MedPIC evaluation on 467 questions, 2,335 options and 244 changing option pairs. Set EM requires the complete answer set to match. RMS is in logits and direction degradation is a count.
acl_captions.10: Results for 216 label-preserving MedPIC option pairs. Patient facts still change, so these pairs are not assumed to be pure interference. RMS values refer to base, edited and correction differences, in logits.
acl_captions.11: Legal-set decoding and bias adaptation on 324 fixed MedPIC error questions. Each bias is fitted on 93 separate development questions. Counts are subset results rather than full-test accuracy.
acl_captions.12: Legal-set paired accuracy on 177 fixed changing MedPIC error pairs, before and after bias adaptation. ER, correction RMS and direction counts use continuous scores; a shared bias cancels in paired differences.
acl_captions.13: MedPIC score simulation, averaged equally over five models after five-seed averaging within each model. Pair EM uses 92 synthetic case pairs, Set EM uses 467 questions, and direction degradation uses eligible changing option pairs. RMS is in synthetic score units. \textbf{Prespecified simulation; the corresponding models and datasets were not evaluated. Replace with measured results.}
acl_captions.14: MedPAIR score simulation, averaged equally over five models and five generation seeds. Key-Del. Ret. measures fixed-margin deletion sensitivity rather than label-changing ER. Accuracy is evaluated only on 898 complete original questions; RMS is in score units. \textbf{Prespecified simulation; the corresponding models and datasets were not evaluated. Replace with measured results.}
acl_captions.15: MedEinst score simulation on 5,383 synthetic control/trap pairs per seed. Results average five models and five generation seeds. Direction degradation conditions on originally positive responses; BTR conditions on correct control predictions. RMS is in score units. \textbf{Prespecified simulation; the corresponding models and datasets were not evaluated. Replace with measured results.}
acl_captions.16: MedGUIDE score simulation on 7,747 questions and 17 unequal disease groups per seed. Disease Macro Acc. weights groups equally. Undefined intervention metrics are shown as dashes. \textbf{Prespecified simulation; the corresponding models and datasets were not evaluated. Replace with measured results.}
acl_captions.17: TrialGPT score simulation on 750 known labels after excluding 250 unknown labels. Results average five models and five generation seeds. Undefined intervention metrics are shown as dashes. \textbf{Prespecified simulation; the corresponding models and datasets were not evaluated. Replace with measured results.}
acl_captions.18: Ablations on the controlled held-out data. Rows vary the evidence constraint, trace dimension and subspace. RMS is in logits; node and path counts retain their own denominators.
acl_captions.19: Correction function and intervention-location comparisons using the same 16-dimensional trace. Nonlinear and representation methods report mean and sample standard deviation across three training seeds. Coefficients include the separately fitted bias; RMS is in logits.
